info.title: EcoLunch — Onboarding Admin API
info.description: Backend for the EcoLunch onboarding admin portal. Node + Express · MongoDB (data) · PostgreSQL (banking). Admin-only — simple JWT login, no roles. Log in via POST /auth/login, then click **Authorize** and paste the token to try the protected /admin/* endpoints.

post.description: Attaches a document, contract request, Smart Import item, validation item, or Go-live blocker to an existing ticket. A ticket can hold more than one linked item.

400.description: Item is already linked to this ticket

patch.description: Priority could previously only be set once, at ticket creation — this allows escalating/de-escalating an already-open ticket.

post.summary: Reply to a conversation
post.description: Send a message and automatically set conversation status to "waiting_for_caterer" to indicate admin action. Atomic operation.

201.description: Reply sent and status updated successfully

post.summary: Close a conversation
post.description: Mark a conversation as closed (archived). Sets status to "closed" and records closedAt timestamp. Cannot close already-closed or resolved conversations.

400.description: Cannot close - conversation already closed or resolved

post.summary: Reopen a closed conversation
post.description: Reopen a closed conversation by setting status back to "open". Can only reopen conversations that are currently closed.

400.description: Cannot reopen - conversation is not closed

post.summary: Resolve a conversation
post.description:
Mark a conversation as resolved and trigger automatic module integration:
- Updates linked onboarding record (if applicable)
- Notifies originating module (Validation, Documents, Contracts, Go-live, Modules & Pricing, Corrections)
- Recalculates onboarding progress where required
- Logs all actions to audit trail

200.description: Conversation resolved successfully with module integration

400.description: Cannot resolve - already resolved, closed, or has blockers
